const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html,application/rss+xml,application/json'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "const targets=[",
 " ['algora_api','https://console.algora.io/api/bounties?limit=20'],",
 " ['algora_orgs','https://algora.io/bounties'],",
 " ['upwork_rss','https://www.upwork.com/ab/feed/jobs/rss?q=automation&sort=recency'],",
 " ['fiverr_search','https://www.fiverr.com/search/gigs?query=automation'],",
 " ['gumroad_discover','https://gumroad.com/discover'],",
 " ['appsumo','https://appsumo.com/']",
 "];",
 "(async function(){",
 " for(const t of targets){",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(t[1]);",
 " console.log('=== '+t[0]+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length);",
 " const m=/<title[^>]*>([\\s\\S]{0,200}?)<\\/title>/i.exec(r.body);",
 " console.log(' title:', m?m[1].replace(/\\s+/g,' ').substring(0,110):'(none)');",
 " console.log(' head:', r.body.substring(0,250).replace(/\\s+/g,' '));",
 " }catch(e){ console.log(t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,4000)});",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ov3.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ov3.cjs";
